description: This file defines a DeploymentProcessor class responsible for managing deployment requests via GitHub API, including selecting deployment configurations and processing deployment steps based on different deployment modes.

classes.name: DeploymentProcessor
classes.description: A class that handles deployment requests, interacts with GitHub API, and manages deployment configurations based on deployment modes.

methods.name: requestDeployment
methods.description: Asynchronously requests a deployment by selecting configuration, fetching commit data, and processing deployment steps based on deployment mode.
